Town and lots: swipe to pan; pinch to zoom and twist to rotate. Swipe along lists to scroll. Select an object position, then use Rotate, Place or Cancel. Hold a selected catalog icon for its description. Drag a catalog object onto the lot to preview it. Hold its position with one finger and turn a second finger to rotate without moving the camera. A short simultaneous two-finger tap cancels the object or any building tool, including walls. Moving two fingers controls the camera; choose the object position again afterwards. Flooring/wallpaper: hold and release to fill an area. Outdoors, flooring can fill the outside area of the lot. A second finger or Back cancels preparation. Building tools apply on release; interrupted changes may leave a partial result. Hold a control for right-click actions, such as locking a want. Swipe two fingers vertically together to tilt the camera. Use Select on a gamepad for its controls. Interface scale is in the game graphics options. The effective UI scale is limited when needed so windows fit the screen. On the first screen, swipe horizontally to change towns. Swipe three fingers together up or down to change floors.

Game executables are missing or unsupported. Select the Legacy Collection 2025 installation containing Sims2EP9.exe and ijl15.dll in EP9/TSBin.

Left stick: pointer; A: select, then place; B: cancel/Back; X: right click; Y: pause. Right stick: camera pan; hold right stick: tilt. Triggers: zoom; shoulders: rotate camera or selected object. D-pad: scroll list at pointer. Start: interface settings; Select: this help. Left stick pressed: precise pointer.
Swipe along the clock or speed buttons: right to speed up, left to slow down and pause. The scale in the centre shows the selected speed.

The controls above and the FPS counter update immediately. Language and rendering choices take effect when the game restarts. FSR, FXAA and MSAA require OpenGL ES. The game disables MSAA if the device does not support it.
